Upper bound 193656: the next named global Online_Store-adjacent `s_onlineReleaseGuardedPtrM` sits at s_instance (0x14451E000) + 0x2F478 = 193656 (xref from data at 0x14454D478). Best estimate 193648 (the gap of 8 bytes to the next global is unexplained by any Replay access).
